title: Why Is Gas So Expensive Right Now? (2026 Oil Shock Explained)
description:
In January, a gallon of regular gas cost about $2.78. By May it hit $4.50, and it's still around $4.27. So where is all that money going, and when will it come down?

Penny the coin explains the 2026 gas price spike with real data: the Strait of Hormuz and the war with Iran, how oil more than doubled, how a barrel becomes a gallon (and what you pay for), why America's own oil doesn't protect you, past oil shocks since 1990, why prices rise like rockets and fall like feathers, how diesel pushes up food and everything else, what it costs your family, and what could bring prices down.
